summary: CityPulse iteration 3 validation complete. Backend: 47/47 pytest pass (32 iter1+iter2 regression + 15 new iter3). Verified: GET /api/places returns exactly 35 lieux, every address matches ^\d+.*\d{5} .+ (number + CP5 + ville), category=fastfood=11, category=fleuriste=3, couple=true returns places all tagged 'couple'. GET /api/rene/greeting returns greeting/suggestion/places/quick_actions; adult has all 6 actions (fastfood/fleuriste/verre/club/idee/pluie); minor has verre/club filtered out and gets 'aprem' extra action, no bar/club in suggested places. POST /api/rene/chat (Claude, ~8-12s) returns {user, assistant} with assistant.text, places (<=3, all valid IDs), follow_ups; minor never receives bar/club places across actions idee/aprem/fastfood. GET+DELETE /api/rene/history round-trip works (clear sets to []). Planner people=2, 10h-22h creates the 'cadeau' slot between 17h-19h; fastfood can be slotted at dejeuner/diner. Regression on auth/me, deals, favorites toggle, itinerary CRUD all green. Frontend (390x844, seeded session): 5-tab bar (tab-rene/discover/deals/planner/profile) renders without overflow on René by default. René home shows rene-proactive-suggestion + rene-budget-pill + place cards with full addresses (e.g. '5 Place du Grand Marché, 37000 Tours'). All 6 rene-quick-* chips visible. Tapping rene-quick-fastfood shows chat-typing indicator then a René bubble + chat-follow-up-{0,1,2} chips (fastfood response correctly cites Poke House, Berliner Das Original, Burger King). Budget sheet opens via rene-budget-pill and rene-budget-30 is tappable. rene-clear-button visible. Discover tab: filter-category-fastfood / filter-category-fleuriste / filter-couple chips present and tappable; Carte toggle renders iframe with 35 .pin markers (matches catalogue). tab-deals, tab-planner, tab-profile all navigate. React Native: no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch. Only the pre-existing benign RNW 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning persists (reanimated internal). ONE KNOWN BACKEND BUG discovered during planner testing: the 'cadeau' slot is created for couples 17h-19h but is NEVER filled with a fleuriste place; it falls through to a 'Temps libre' free step. Root cause: fleuriste places have duration_min=20 (0.33h) which is filtered out by the planner's `stay < 0.5` guard in planner.py around line 162. The slot label fallback is also wrong (shows 'Temps libre' instead of 'Bouquet' when the slot is 'cadeau').

minor.issue: 'cadeau' slot never filled with a fleuriste because fleuriste duration_min=20 fails the `stay < 0.5h` filter in planner.py:162. Also, when the slot falls through to the free-step branch (planner.py:223) the label is hardcoded to 'Temps libre' instead of SLOT_LABELS[slot] ('Bouquet'). Fix: raise fleuriste duration_min to 30+ or lower the min-stay threshold to 0.3h for 'cadeau' slot; and keep SLOT_LABELS[slot] in the free-step fallback.

rca_of_issue: Bouquet (cadeau) step never filled with a fleuriste. Reproduction: POST /api/planner/generate {people:2,start:'10:00',end:'22:00',budget:120+} with seeds 1..24 — every response contains a step with slot='cadeau' between 17h and 19h, but kind='free' and slot_label='Temps libre'. Trace: planner.py builds candidates for slot='cadeau' with cats=['fleuriste']; the 3 fleuriste places have duration_min=20 → stay=min(20/60, end-arrival)=0.33h; the guard `if stay < 0.5` (line 162) drops all candidates, so the branch at line 220 inserts a free step with hardcoded label 'Temps libre'. Mitigation: (a) raise fleuriste duration_min to 30-40 in data.py NEW_PLACES, OR (b) lower the min-stay filter to 0.25h just for slot in ('cadeau',), AND fix slot_label fallback at line 223 to SLOT_LABELS.get(slot, 'Temps libre') so the UI still shows 'Bouquet'.
